mapping_policy: Strongest reasonable combination; no hindsight importation of the GBI-specific Authorization -> Instantiation Boundary -> ISP dependency.

AUTH_RESERVE_ONLY.teaching: RSVP/RFC/ITU-style authorization/admission before resource reservation or commitment
AUTH_RESERVE_ONLY.structural_model: prospective participant may already exist structurally; denial prevents MRC/resource reservation but does not retroactively erase ISP

S103_STRONG_COMBINATION.structural_model: policy decision can precede service/resource commitment while the VM structural participant may already have crossed into instantiated participation

S103_COMBINATION_PLUS_GBI.teaching: identical strong combination plus GBI dependency intervention
S103_COMBINATION_PLUS_GBI.structural_model: authorization is made antecedent to Instantiation Boundary crossing; denied candidates do not acquire ISP or MRC

DISPLACED_GBI.teaching: same decision logic moved after ISP
DISPLACED_GBI.structural_model: participant acquires ISP before governance outcome; denied participation is discarded afterward

RANDOM_GATE.structural_model: random pre-instantiation exclusion at same expected rate; fidelity errors expected

fail_closed_checks: Strong-combination arms may gate MRC/resource commitment before work but may not un-count already acquired ISP.
S103_COMBINATION_PLUS_GBI must differ from S103_STRONG_COMBINATION only by pre-instantiation dependency placement.
GBI-designated arms require decision before boundary crossing and MRC only after ISP.
Fidelity errors in RANDOM_GATE are retained, never normalized away.
